title: Stop, Don't Talk to Me
blurb: Being rejected is one thing. Being rejected melodically is a different experience entirely. The sung dismissal took off on TikTok because the tune does something a flat no cannot — it makes the refusal feel pre-planned, almost choreographed, as though your approach had been anticipated and rehearsed for. It became the standard soundtrack for shutting down unwanted attention, group chat drama, and anybody opening a sentence with the word 'actually'. Musical, final, and structurally impossible to argue with, since you would have to argue in key.
origin: A viral sung dismissal from TikTok.
